projects.title: Huffman Coding Project
projects.description: Implemented the Huffman Coding algorithm to compress data files and later decompress them.  The program converted ASCII characters into bits, calculated their frequencies and constructed a Huffman binary tree and encoded the message.  This reduced the amount of memory needed to store the file and consequently, reduced the time needed to send the file over the internet.  I was also the only one to figure out how to use the Huffman Code to compress the header file as well.

projects.title: Used Verilog and VDHL to simulate a vending machine on an FPGA board.
projects.description: This project required us to work in Verilog and VDHL in order to simulate a vending machine.  We had to program buttons that let us increment in case the user added nickels, dimes, quarters, dollars or used a credit card.  The machine would then dispense the correct amount of change depending on what the user inserted into the machine.  This required us to program the registers on the board to store the amount of money the user entered in if the minimum amount of money for a unit was not reached.
